calendar_principles: Treat bp's quarterly results and AGM as the primary planning triggers; dates here are illustrative until confirmed against bp's published financial calendar.
Observe market-sensitive quiet periods before results - no new investor-facing creative in the closed period.
Treat energy and business conferences as GBE attention moments that justify phasing and contextual targeting, not automatic budget increases.
Use premium sport (Wimbledon, The Open, British Grand Prix) only as high-attention CTV context for the GBE, never as a messaging hook.
Flag unconfirmed or proxy events visibly so agents cannot overclaim source truth.

events.name: World Economic Forum Annual Meeting, Davos
events.planning_implication: Davos concentrates global business and policy attention on energy security and the transition. A strong moment for premium financial news CTV and contextual display around energy and markets coverage, ahead of the February results quiet period.
channel_actions: Contextual display on energy and markets coverage

events.name: Full-year 2025 results and strategy update (illustrative date)
events.planning_implication: The year's most important investor moment: full-year results and the strategy update. Hold investor-facing creative until the announcement, then concentrate CTV and online video to carry the equity story, with PMP display on financial publishers for analysts.

events.name: International Energy Week, London
events.planning_implication: London's flagship energy industry gathering lands straight after full-year results, extending the window in which UK GBE audiences are reading about energy strategy.

events.name: CERAWeek, Houston
events.planning_implication: The leading global energy executive conference. Coverage drives GBE attention on capital allocation and upstream strategy; a good fit for financial news CTV and contextual targeting, with the US audience flagged for the future US data pipeline.

events.name: AGM and first-quarter results window (illustrative dates)
events.planning_implication: The AGM gives shareholders a direct moment with the board, followed by Q1 results at the end of the month. Use premium video for shareholder-facing content and keep display focused on financial publishers.

events.name: May bank holidays and post-results follow-through
events.planning_implication: A lighter month after Q1 results. Use it for measurement - test Online Video and Meta GBE match quality against IPSOS IGI before the Q2 window.

events.name: FIFA World Cup opening weeks
events.planning_implication: Football fragments broadcast attention and inflates CTV pricing. Keep investor activity light and avoid overpaying for CTV around fixtures; this is context, not a planning trigger for bp Investment Communications.
channel_actions: Hold CTV weight down around fixtures

events.name: Wimbledon, The Open and British Grand Prix; Q2 results build
events.planning_implication: Premium summer sport over-indexes with the GBE and offers high-attention, brand-safe CTV context. Build presence late in the month ahead of the early-August Q2 results.

events.name: Second-quarter results (illustrative date) and summer lull
events.planning_implication: Q2 results fall in the quietest month for GBE media consumption. Concentrate spend in results week and keep the rest of the month lean.

events.name: Gastech conference
events.planning_implication: The major global gas and LNG conference, as GBE audiences return from summer. A good moment for contextual display and Meta amplification around gas and LNG coverage.
channel_actions: Contextual display on gas and LNG coverage

events.name: Q3 results build and annual-plan sign-off window
events.planning_implication: Build presence ahead of early-November Q3 results and use the window as a governance checkpoint before the November push.

events.name: Q3 results (illustrative date), ADIPEC and COP31
events.planning_implication: The busiest month of the year: Q3 results coincide with ADIPEC in Abu Dhabi and COP31, putting energy strategy at the centre of GBE coverage. Rationale must show where spend avoids year-end CPM inflation.
channel_actions: Contextual display around ADIPEC and COP31 coverage

events.name: Year-end lull and Christmas bank holidays
events.planning_implication: GBE attention falls away and year-end CPMs are inflated. Keep a light always-on contextual presence and prepare for the February full-year results quiet period.
